primitives.name: Scoped Deposit Wallet Session-Key Authorization
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## 0.2.0 ### Minor Changes - 0db340d: Add scoped Deposit Wallet session-key authorization, active-key fetching, revocation, and ordinary SecureClient support for authorized session signers.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'Session key identifier (dimensionless)', 'A': 'Authorization scope (enum or string)', 'K': 'Active key set (set of cryptographic keys)', 'R': 'Revocation status (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Session keys are ephemeral, scopes are finite, and revocation is atomic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A is omitted, defaults to ALL scope; when R is true, S becomes invalid.

layer2.mapping: Session key lifecycle modeled as a Markov chain over authorization states.
layer2.telemetry: Key rotation frequency, revocation latency, scope mismatch count

primitives.name: Node.js Runtime Minimum Version Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: - 0dc6339: Declare Node.js 24 as the minimum supported runtime for published SDK packages.
primitives.assumptions: SDKs require V_min features for correct operation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If T < V_min, SDK fails at initialization.

layer2.mapping: Runtime compatibility kernel derived from feature availability in T.
layer2.telemetry: Environment version check success rate, compatibility error logs

primitives.name: Breaking Removal of Neverthrow Exports
primitives.verbatim_quote: # @polymarket/types ## 0.3.0 ### Minor Changes - 8e79e95: Breaking: remove `neverthrow` exports and `unwrap`.
primitives.assumptions: Neverthrow is replaced by direct async handling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If E contains neverthrow, F becomes true.

layer2.mapping: Error propagation modeled as a fiber-state transition in an async monad.
layer2.telemetry: API usage deviation from expected patterns, error recovery time
